from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection, identifying itself and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    publication_year: str | None = Field(description="The publication year of this paper, useful for verifying sequential citation order")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER papers in the provided collection that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all provided papers for citation chain analysis."""
    papers: list[Paper]
